    iPressureDegradedMode := 1;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Pressure Sensor A Failed *)
ELSIF bPressureFault_B AND NOT bPressureFault_A AND NOT bPressureFault_C THEN
    (* Channel B Failed: 1oo2 Average Voting between A and C *)
    rVotedReactorPressure_bar := (rMicroreactorPressure_A_bar + rMicroreactorPressure_C_bar) * 0.50;
    iPressureDegradedMode := 1;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Pressure Sensor B Failed *)
ELSIF bPressureFault_C AND NOT bPressureFault_A AND NOT bPressureFault_B THEN
    (* Channel C Failed: 1oo2 Average Voting between A and B *)
    rVotedReactorPressure_bar := (rMicroreactorPressure_A_bar + rMicroreactorPressure_B_bar) * 0.50;
    iPressureDegradedMode := 1;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: Pressure Sensor C Failed *)
ELSIF NOT bPressureFault_A AND bPressureFault_B AND bPressureFault_C THEN
    (* Dual Failure: 1oo1 Degraded Mode on Surviving Channel A *)
    rVotedReactorPressure_bar := rMicroreactorPressure_A_bar;
    iPressureDegradedMode := 2;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000080; (* Bit 7: Pressure Degraded 1oo1 Mode *)
ELSIF bPressureFault_A AND NOT bPressureFault_B AND bPressureFault_C THEN
    (* Dual Failure: 1oo1 Degraded Mode on Surviving Channel B *)
    rVotedReactorPressure_bar := rMicroreactorPressure_B_bar;
    iPressureDegradedMode := 2;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000080;
ELSIF bPressureFault_A AND bPressureFault_B AND NOT bPressureFault_C THEN
    (* Dual Failure: 1oo1 Degraded Mode on Surviving Channel C *)
    rVotedReactorPressure_bar := rMicroreactorPressure_C_bar;
    iPressureDegradedMode := 2;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000080;
ELSE
    (* Triple Sensor Failure or Unresolvable Discrepancy: Fail-Safe Emergency Trip *)
    iPressureDegradedMode := 3;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000100; (* Bit 8: All Pressure Sensors Faulty *)
    bProductHarvestValve := FALSE;
    bLedPowerEnable := FALSE;
    bMajorAlarmActive := TRUE;
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Low-Pass Filter on Voted Operating Pressure (Time Constant tau = 100 ms) *)
rFiltPressure_bar := rFiltPressure_bar + 0.1667 * (rVotedReactorPressure_bar - rFiltPressure_bar);

(* --- 2.2 LED Heat Sink Substrate Temperature 2oo3 TMR Voting --- *)
tDiscrepancyTimer_T_AB(IN := (ABS(rLedSubstrateTemp_A_degC - rLedSubstrateTemp_B_degC) > rDISCREPANCY_TOL_TEMP_DEGC),
                       PT := tDISCREPANCY_DEBOUNCE_TIME);
tDiscrepancyTimer_T_BC(IN := (ABS(rLedSubstrateTemp_B_degC - rLedSubstrateTemp_C_degC) > rDISCREPANCY_TOL_TEMP_DEGC),
                       PT := tDISCREPANCY_DEBOUNCE_TIME);
tDiscrepancyTimer_T_CA(IN := (ABS(rLedSubstrateTemp_C_degC - rLedSubstrateTemp_A_degC) > rDISCREPANCY_TOL_TEMP_DEGC),
                       PT := tDISCREPANCY_DEBOUNCE_TIME);

bSubstrateTempFault_A := tDiscrepancyTimer_T_AB.Q AND tDiscrepancyTimer_T_CA.Q;
bSubstrateTempFault_B := tDiscrepancyTimer_T_AB.Q AND tDiscrepancyTimer_T_BC.Q;
bSubstrateTempFault_C := tDiscrepancyTimer_T_BC.Q AND tDiscrepancyTimer_T_CA.Q;

IF NOT bSubstrateTempFault_A AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_B AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_C THEN
    rTempCandidate_1 := rLedSubstrateTemp_A_degC;
    rTempCandidate_2 := rLedSubstrateTemp_B_degC;
    rTempCandidate_3 := rLedSubstrateTemp_C_degC;
    IF rTempCandidate_1 > rTempCandidate_2 THEN
        rSwapTemp := rTempCandidate_1; rTempCandidate_1 := rTempCandidate_2; rTempCandidate_2 := rSwapTemp;
    END_IF;
    IF rTempCandidate_2 > rTempCandidate_3 THEN
        rSwapTemp := rTempCandidate_2; rTempCandidate_2 := rTempCandidate_3; rTempCandidate_3 := rSwapTemp;
    END_IF;
    IF rTempCandidate_1 > rTempCandidate_2 THEN
        rSwapTemp := rTempCandidate_1; rTempCandidate_1 := rTempCandidate_2; rTempCandidate_2 := rSwapTemp;
    END_IF;
    rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC := rTempCandidate_2;
    iSubstrateTempDegradedMode := 0;
ELSIF bSubstrateTempFault_A AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_B AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_C THEN
    rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC := (rLedSubstrateTemp_B_degC + rLedSubstrateTemp_C_degC) * 0.50;
    iSubstrateTempDegradedMode := 1;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000200; (* Bit 9: Substrate Temp Sensor A Fault *)
ELSIF bSubstrateTempFault_B AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_A AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_C THEN
    rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC := (rLedSubstrateTemp_A_degC + rLedSubstrateTemp_C_degC) * 0.50;
    iSubstrateTempDegradedMode := 1;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000400; (* Bit 10: Substrate Temp Sensor B Fault *)
ELSIF bSubstrateTempFault_C AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_A AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_B THEN
    rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC := (rLedSubstrateTemp_A_degC + rLedSubstrateTemp_B_degC) * 0.50;
    iSubstrateTempDegradedMode := 1;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000800; (* Bit 11: Substrate Temp Sensor C Fault *)
ELSIF NOT bSubstrateTempFault_A AND bSubstrateTempFault_B AND bSubstrateTempFault_C THEN
    rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC := rLedSubstrateTemp_A_degC;
    iSubstrateTempDegradedMode := 2;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00001000; (* Bit 12: Substrate Temp 1oo1 Mode *)
ELSIF bSubstrateTempFault_A AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_B AND bSubstrateTempFault_C THEN
    rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC := rLedSubstrateTemp_B_degC;
    iSubstrateTempDegradedMode := 2;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00001000;
ELSIF bSubstrateTempFault_A AND bSubstrateTempFault_B AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_C THEN
    rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC := rLedSubstrateTemp_C_degC;
    iSubstrateTempDegradedMode := 2;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00001000;
ELSE
    iSubstrateTempDegradedMode := 3;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00002000; (* Bit 13: All Temp Sensors Faulty *)
    bProductHarvestValve := FALSE;
    bLedPowerEnable := FALSE;
    bMajorAlarmActive := TRUE;
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Critical High-High Thermal Runaway Trip Check *)
IF rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC >= rTEMP_RUNAWAY_TRIP_DEGC THEN
    bProductHarvestValve := FALSE;
    bLedPowerEnable := FALSE;
    rLedDriveCurrent_mA := 0.0;
    bMajorAlarmActive := TRUE;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00004000; (* Bit 14: Thermal Runaway High-High Trip *)
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Critical High-High Overpressure Microchannel Rupture Trip Check *)
IF rVotedReactorPressure_bar >= rPRESSURE_BURST_TRIP_BAR THEN
    bProductHarvestValve := FALSE;
    bLedPowerEnable := FALSE;
    rPumpFlowSetpoint_mlpm := 0.0;
    bQuenchSolventFlushValve := TRUE;
    bMajorAlarmActive := TRUE;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00008000; (* Bit 15: Pressure Burst High-High Trip *)
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* === SECTION 3: MULTIPHASE SLUG FLOW HYDRODYNAMICS & OPTICAL RESIDENCE TIME ESTIMATION         === *)
(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* Convert Liquid Volumetric Flow from [ml/min] to SI [m3/s] *)
rLiquidFlow_tot_m3s := (rReagentFlow_A_mlpm + rReagentFlow_B_mlpm) * 1.66667e-8;

(* Actual Volumetric Gas Flow Rate accounting for Operating Pressure & Temperature *)
(* Ideal Gas Equation: Q_gas,act = Q_gas,sccm * (P_std / P_voted) * (T_fluid / T_std) *)
IF rVotedReactorPressure_bar > 0.20 THEN
    rGasFlow_actual_m3s := (rSegmentingGasFlow_sccm * 1.66667e-8) *
                           (rSTD_PRESSURE_BAR / rVotedReactorPressure_bar) *
                           ((rCoolingJacketTemp_degC + 273.15) / rSTD_TEMPERATURE_K);
ELSE
    rGasFlow_actual_m3s := rSegmentingGasFlow_sccm * 1.66667e-8;
END_IF;

(* Total Two-Phase Multiphase Volumetric Flow Rate [m3/s] *)
rTotalMixtureFlow_m3s := rLiquidFlow_tot_m3s + rGasFlow_actual_m3s;

(* Dynamic Volumetric Gas Holdup / Void Fraction epsilon_G *)
IF rTotalMixtureFlow_m3s > 1.0e-12 THEN
    rGasVoidFraction := rGasFlow_actual_m3s / rTotalMixtureFlow_m3s;
    rMixtureVelocity_ms := rTotalMixtureFlow_m3s / rCHANNEL_CROSS_AREA_M2;
ELSE
    rGasVoidFraction := 0.0;
    rMixtureVelocity_ms := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Capillary Number Ca = mu_L * u_m / gamma *)
rCapillaryNumber := (rSOLVENT_DYNAMIC_VISC_PAS * rMixtureVelocity_ms) / rSOLVENT_SURFACE_TENS_NM;

(* Aussillous-Quere Formulation for Capillary Lubrication Liquid Film Thickness delta *)
(* delta / R = (1.34 * Ca^(2/3)) / (1.0 + 3.35 * Ca^(2/3)) *)
IF rCapillaryNumber > 1.0e-7 THEN
    rTaylorFilmThickness_um := (0.50 * rCHANNEL_DIAMETER_M * 1.0e6) *
                               ((1.34 * EXPT(rCapillaryNumber, 0.666667)) /
                               (1.0 + 3.35 * EXPT(rCapillaryNumber, 0.666667)));
ELSE
    rTaylorFilmThickness_um := 0.50; (* Boundary Minimum Film Thickness [um] *)
END_IF;

(* Taylor Liquid Slug Characteristic Length & Internal Turnover Frequency *)
rSlugLength_m := 3.50 * rCHANNEL_DIAMETER_M; (* Typical Taylor slug aspect ratio L_slug ~ 3.5 * D_ch *)
IF rSlugLength_m > 1.0e-6 THEN
    rSlugFrequency_Hz := rMixtureVelocity_ms / (2.0 * rSlugLength_m);
ELSE
    rSlugFrequency_Hz := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* True Optical Residence Time within the Irradiated Microchannel Volume tau_opt = V_irr / Q_tot *)
IF rTotalMixtureFlow_m3s > 1.0e-12 THEN
    rOpticalResidenceTime_s := rIRRADIATED_VOLUME_M3 / rTotalMixtureFlow_m3s;
ELSE
    rOpticalResidenceTime_s := 9999.0;
END_IF;

(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* === SECTION 4: IN-LINE UV-VIS PHOTOMETRIC PURITY & KINETIC CONVERSION DECONVOLUTION            === *)
(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* Exponential Moving Average (EMA) Digital Filtering of Absorbance Signals (alpha = 0.20) *)
rFiltAbs_Prod_AU := rFiltAbs_Prod_AU + 0.20 * (rUvVisAbsorbance_Prod_AU - rFiltAbs_Prod_AU);
rFiltAbs_Imp_AU  := rFiltAbs_Imp_AU  + 0.20 * (rUvVisAbsorbance_Imp_AU  - rFiltAbs_Imp_AU);
rFiltAbs_Ref_AU  := rFiltAbs_Ref_AU  + 0.20 * (rUvVisAbsorbance_Ref_AU  - rFiltAbs_Ref_AU);

(* Reference Turbidity Baseline Subtraction to Eliminate Gas Slug Bubble Diffraction *)
rAbs_Prod_corr := rFiltAbs_Prod_AU - rFiltAbs_Ref_AU;
IF rAbs_Prod_corr < 0.0 THEN
    rAbs_Prod_corr := 0.0;
END_IF;

rAbs_Imp_corr := rFiltAbs_Imp_AU - rFiltAbs_Ref_AU;
IF rAbs_Imp_corr < 0.0 THEN
    rAbs_Imp_corr := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Analytical Inversion of 2x2 Beer-Lambert Molar Extinction Matrix *)
(* [ A1_corr ]   [ eps1_prod   eps1_prec ] [ C_prod ]                     *)
(* [ A2_corr ] = [ eps2_prod   eps2_prec ] [ C_prec ] * b_path            *)
rDetExtinction := (rEPSILON_1_PROD * rEPSILON_2_PREC) - (rEPSILON_1_PREC * rEPSILON_2_PROD);

IF ABS(rDetExtinction) > 1.0e-3 THEN
    (* Path length in cm: b_path = rSPECTRO_PATH_LENGTH_M * 100.0 = 0.10 cm *)
    rCalcConc_Prod_M := (1.0 / (0.10 * rDetExtinction)) *
                        (rEPSILON_2_PREC * rAbs_Prod_corr - rEPSILON_1_PREC * rAbs_Imp_corr);
    rCalcConc_Prec_M := (1.0 / (0.10 * rDetExtinction)) *
                        (-rEPSILON_2_PROD * rAbs_Prod_corr + rEPSILON_1_PROD * rAbs_Imp_corr);
ELSE
    rCalcConc_Prod_M := 0.0;
    rCalcConc_Prec_M := rNOMINAL_FEED_CONC_M;
END_IF;

(* Clamping Non-Physical Negative Concentrations *)
IF rCalcConc_Prod_M < 0.0 THEN rCalcConc_Prod_M := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rCalcConc_Prec_M < 0.0 THEN rCalcConc_Prec_M := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Over-Irradiation Degradation Impurity Estimation *)
rCalcConc_Imp_M := rNOMINAL_FEED_CONC_M - (rCalcConc_Prod_M + rCalcConc_Prec_M);
IF rCalcConc_Imp_M < 0.0 THEN rCalcConc_Imp_M := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Total Dissolved Oncology Species *)
rTotalMolarSpecies := rCalcConc_Prod_M + rCalcConc_Prec_M + rCalcConc_Imp_M;

(* Real-Time Chemical Purity [%] *)
IF rTotalMolarSpecies > 1.0e-6 THEN
    rPhotometricPurity_pct := (rCalcConc_Prod_M / rTotalMolarSpecies) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rPhotometricPurity_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Reagent Conversion Fraction [%] *)
IF rNOMINAL_FEED_CONC_M > 1.0e-6 THEN
    rReactionConversion_pct := ((rNOMINAL_FEED_CONC_M - rCalcConc_Prec_M) / rNOMINAL_FEED_CONC_M) * 100.0;
    rPhotochemicalYield_pct := (rCalcConc_Prod_M / rNOMINAL_FEED_CONC_M) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rReactionConversion_pct := 0.0;
    rPhotochemicalYield_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* In-Situ Photonic Radiant Flux Delivery [umol photons / s = uEin / s] *)
(* q_p,0 = (I_opt * A_irr * lambda) / (h * c * N_A) *)
rPhotonFlux_uEin_s := ((rOpticalIrradiance_Wcm2 * 1.0e4 * rIRRADIATED_APERTURE_M2 * (rWavelength_Target_nm * 1.0e-9)) /
                       (rPLANCK_CONSTANT * rSPEED_OF_LIGHT * rAVOGADRO_CONSTANT)) * 1.0e6;

(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* === SECTION 5: HIGH-POWER MULTI-WAVELENGTH LED HEAT DISSIPATION & PELTIER TEC CONTROL          === *)
(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* Temperature-Compensated Diode Forward Voltage Calculation *)
rForwardVoltage_V := rLED_NOMINAL_VF_V + rLED_TEMP_COEFF_VK * (rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC - 25.0);
IF rForwardVoltage_V < 28.0 THEN rForwardVoltage_V := 28.0; END_IF;

(* Electrical & Thermal Dissipation Rates *)
rP_electrical_W := (rLedDriveCurrent_mA * 1.0e-3) * rForwardVoltage_V;
rP_thermal_W    := rP_electrical_W * (1.0 - rLED_OPTICAL_EFFICIENCY);

(* Real-Time Estimated p-n Junction Temperature Tj = T_sink + P_th * R_th,js *)
rEstimatedJunctionTemp_degC := rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC + (rP_thermal_W * rLED_THERMAL_RESIST_KW);

(* Center Emission Wavelength Thermal Red-Shift *)
rWavelengthDrift_nm := rLED_WAVELENGTH_COEFF_NMK * (rEstimatedJunctionTemp_degC - 25.0);

(* Peltier Thermoelectric Cooler (TEC) Closed-Loop Anti-Windup PID Regulation *)
(* Feedforward Power Rejection based on instantaneous LED thermal dissipation *)
rPeltier_Feedforward := (rP_thermal_W / 120.0) * 45.0; (* 45% duty feedforward at nominal 120W heat *)

(* Feedback Error based on Substrate Temperature vs Target Setpoint *)
rGradValue := rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC - rTargetFluidTemp_degC; (* Temperature error e(t) *)

(* Integral Error Accumulation with Anti-Windup Clamping *)
rPeltier_Integral := rPeltier_Integral + rPeltier_Ki * rGradValue * 0.020;
IF rPeltier_Integral > 35.0 THEN
    rPeltier_Integral := 35.0;
ELSIF rPeltier_Integral < -15.0 THEN
    rPeltier_Integral := -15.0;
END_IF;

(* Total Peltier Actuator Command Calculation *)
rPeltierDriveDuty_pct := (rPeltier_Kp * rGradValue) +
                         rPeltier_Integral +
                         (rPeltier_Kd * (rGradValue - rPeltier_PrevError) / 0.020) +
                         rPeltier_Feedforward;

rPeltier_PrevError := rGradValue;

(* Actuator Duty Cycle Hard Limits [0.0% to 100.0%] *)
IF rPeltierDriveDuty_pct > 100.0 THEN
    rPeltierDriveDuty_pct := 100.0;
ELSIF rPeltierDriveDuty_pct < 0.0 THEN
    rPeltierDriveDuty_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* === SECTION 6: DISCRETE-TIME STATE-SPACE (A, B, C, D) DYNAMIC MODEL PROPAGATION               === *)
(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* Formulate Deviation State Vector x_state from Nominal Operating Equilibrium *)
x_state[1] := rEstimatedJunctionTemp_degC - 45.0; (* Deviation from nominal Tj = 45 deg C *)
x_state[2] := rCoolingJacketTemp_degC - 20.0;     (* Deviation from nominal T_fluid = 20 deg C *)
x_state[3] := (rReactionConversion_pct - 95.0) * 0.01; (* Conversion fraction deviation *)
x_state[4] := rMixtureVelocity_ms - 0.185;        (* Mixture velocity deviation *)
x_state[5] := rCalcConc_Prod_M - 0.0475;          (* API product concentration deviation *)
x_state[6] := rCalcConc_Imp_M - 0.0012;           (* Byproduct concentration deviation *)

(* Current Control Deviation Vector u_control *)
u_control[1] := rLedDriveCurrent_mA - 2400.0;
u_control[2] := (rReagentFlow_A_mlpm + rReagentFlow_B_mlpm) - 2.50;
u_control[3] := rSegmentingGasFlow_sccm - 5.00;
u_control[4] := rPeltierDriveDuty_pct - 50.0;

(* Matrix Multiplication: x_state_next = A_mat * x_state + B_mat * u_control *)
FOR idx_i := 1 TO 6 DO
    rDotSum := 0.0;
    FOR idx_j := 1 TO 6 DO
        rDotSum := rDotSum + A_mat[idx_i, idx_j] * x_state[idx_j];
    END_FOR;
    FOR idx_k := 1 TO 4 DO
        rDotSum := rDotSum + B_mat[idx_i, idx_k] * u_control[idx_k];
    END_FOR;
    x_state_next[idx_i] := rDotSum;
END_FOR;

(* Output Prediction: y_predicted = C_mat * x_state + D_mat * u_control *)
FOR idx_i := 1 TO 5 DO
    rDotSum := 0.0;
    FOR idx_j := 1 TO 6 DO
        rDotSum := rDotSum + C_mat[idx_i, idx_j] * x_state[idx_j];
    END_FOR;
    FOR idx_k := 1 TO 4 DO
        rDotSum := rDotSum + D_mat[idx_i, idx_k] * u_control[idx_k];
    END_FOR;
    y_predicted[idx_i] := rDotSum;
END_FOR;

(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* === SECTION 7: CONSTRAINED MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC OPTIMIZATION              === *)
(* ================================================================================================= *)
IF bAutoMpcEnable AND (iState = 60 OR iState = 70) THEN
    (* Assemble Supervisory Target Output Deviation Vector *)
    y_setpoint[1] := rTargetPurity_pct - 99.20;       (* Desired Purity Deviation *)
    y_setpoint[2] := 0.650 - 0.620;                   (* Desired Product Absorbance Tracking *)
    y_setpoint[3] := rTargetFluidTemp_degC - 20.0;    (* Desired Fluid Outlet Temp Deviation *)
    y_setpoint[4] := rTargetResidenceTime_s - 45.0;   (* Desired Residence Time Deviation *)
    y_setpoint[5] := rTargetFluidTemp_degC - 22.0;    (* Desired Substrate Temp Deviation *)

    (* Compute Linear Gradient Vector g_mpc = sum( C^T * Q * (y_predicted - y_setpoint) ) *)
    FOR idx_k := 1 TO 4 DO
        g_mpc[idx_k] := 0.0;
        FOR idx_i := 1 TO 5 DO
            g_mpc[idx_k] := g_mpc[idx_k] + D_mat[idx_i, idx_k] * Q_weights[idx_i] * (y_predicted[idx_i] - y_setpoint[idx_i]);
        END_FOR;
        g_mpc[idx_k] := g_mpc[idx_k] + R_weights[idx_k] * delta_u_prev[idx_k];
    END_FOR;

    (* Projected Gradient Descent Solver (12 Fixed Deterministic Iterations) *)
    (* Minimizes (1/2)*delta_u^T*H*delta_u + g^T*delta_u subject to delta_u_min <= delta_u <= delta_u_max *)
    FOR iter_mpc := 1 TO 12 DO
        FOR idx_i := 1 TO 4 DO
            (* Compute Gradient Component: grad_i = sum( H[i,j] * delta_u[j] ) + g[i] *)
            rGradValue := g_mpc[idx_i];
            FOR idx_j := 1 TO 4 DO
                rGradValue := rGradValue + H_mpc[idx_i, idx_j] * delta_u[idx_j];
            END_FOR;

            (* Gradient Step with Fixed Convergence Factor alpha = 0.085 *)
            rDeltaCandidate := delta_u[idx_i] - 0.085 * rGradValue;

            (* Actuator Dynamic Slew Rate Projection *)
            IF rDeltaCandidate > delta_u_max[idx_i] THEN
                rDeltaCandidate := delta_u_max[idx_i];
            ELSIF rDeltaCandidate < -delta_u_max[idx_i] THEN
                rDeltaCandidate := -delta_u_max[idx_i];
            END_IF;

            delta_u[idx_i] := rDeltaCandidate;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Update Previous Slew Register *)
    FOR idx_i := 1 TO 4 DO
        delta_u_prev[idx_i] := delta_u[idx_i];
    END_FOR;

    (* Apply Incremental MPC Trim to Actuator Setpoints *)
    rLedDriveCurrent_mA := rLedDriveCurrent_mA + delta_u[1];
    rPumpFlowSetpoint_mlpm := (rReagentFlow_A_mlpm + rReagentFlow_B_mlpm) + delta_u[2];

    (* Enforce Hard Actuator Absolute Saturation Limits *)
    IF rLedDriveCurrent_mA > u_mpc_max[1] THEN
        rLedDriveCurrent_mA := u_mpc_max[1];
    ELSIF rLedDriveCurrent_mA < u_mpc_min[1] THEN
        rLedDriveCurrent_mA := u_mpc_min[1];
    END_IF;

    IF rPumpFlowSetpoint_mlpm > u_mpc_max[2] THEN
        rPumpFlowSetpoint_mlpm := u_mpc_max[2];
    ELSIF rPumpFlowSetpoint_mlpm < u_mpc_min[2] THEN
        rPumpFlowSetpoint_mlpm := u_mpc_min[2];
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* === SECTION 8: ANSI/ISA-18.2 MULTI-TIER ALARM MANAGEMENT & GRACEFUL DEGRADATION ENGINE         === *)
(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* Reset Transient Warning Bits on Acknowledge Strobe *)
IF bAcknowledgeFaults THEN
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord AND 16#00000001; (* Retain Hardwired E-Stop if still open *)
    bMajorAlarmActive := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Category 2 Process Boundary Excursion Checks *)
IF rVotedReactorPressure_bar >= rPRESSURE_HIGH_ALARM_BAR THEN
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00010000; (* Bit 16: Pressure High Warning *)
END_IF;

IF rVotedReactorPressure_bar <= rPRESSURE_LOW_ALARM_BAR AND iState >= 30 THEN
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00020000; (* Bit 17: Pressure Low / Bubble Collapse Warning *)
END_IF;

IF rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC >= rTEMP_HIGH_ALARM_DEGC THEN
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00040000; (* Bit 18: Substrate Temp High Warning *)
